full_judgment:
12. In the case of Sanmukh singh and others Vs. The king, reported in AIR 1950 PC 31, their Lordships of the Privy Council held as follows: 

 16. We have no doubt that only certified copy of the alleged Sale Deed was produced before the learned SCC Judge and not the original of the said document before the SCC Judge with some ulterior motive. Had the original Deed been produced before the learned SCC Judge, he would not have marked the certified copy of the same as secondary evidence in the SCC Suit. So in view of the Privy Council decision reported in AIR 1950 PC page 31, we hold that the absence of complaint under section 195(i)(c) Cr.P.C by SCC Judge cannot stand as bar to the trial of the accused-petitioners in the present case.
